verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a GitHub mention of an Excalidraw canvas-collaboration example covering plugin install/update, a page API, and a host integration entry point. That points to some official plugin-development surface, but nothing in the pack describes a named, versioned SDK for building against ZCode programmatically. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK (packages, languages, install instructions), API reference documentation, programmatic agent/session control via SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
